The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5a9d714fd656a2c9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n, θ, g, h, V, d have the analytic properties stated at the beginning of this section, with d > 0. Suppose that Equations (3.5) to (3.7) hold with fixed k > 0 and β, and that the weighted gap Equation (4.23) holds. Then V ∉ L3/2 (R3 ) + L∞ (R3 ). Moreover, n is not the density of a ground-state ensemble of any three-electron noninteracting Hamiltonian with a single real, spin-independent potential in this class. These hypotheses are all fixed-parameter hypotheses; no perturbative neighborhood is required.
